name: VRM_FMV_LINES
description: This object stores the fair market values (FMV).

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for a FMV line.

columns.name: PRICING_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Pricing dimension  combination identifier.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Internal Identifier of the FMV template.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the document line.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Code name of the unit of measure.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of a source document items. The valid values are ITEM, MEMO_LINE and ITEM_GROUP.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an item type.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ORG_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an item inventory organization.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_SET_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier for a fair marker value set.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: VSOE price set status. Values are from the lookup: VSOE Price Sets Status.

columns.name: FAIR_MARKET_VALUE
columns.description: A fair market value of an item, item group, or memo line in entered currency.

columns.name: CORP_CURRENCY_FM_VALUE
columns.description: A fair market value of an item, item group, or memo line in corporate currency.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_HIGH_PCT
columns.description: High price percentage of the FMV tolerance range.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_LOW_PCT
columns.description: Low price percentage of the FMV tolerance range.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_LOW
columns.description: Lower limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_HIGH
columns.description: Higher limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: AVERAGE_PRICE
columns.description: An average price of an item, item group, or memo line.

columns.name: HIGHEST_PRICE
columns.description: High price of the tolerance range.

columns.name: LOWEST_PRICE
columns.description: Lowest selling price of standalone sales of an item within a coverage period.

columns.name: LINE_COUNT
columns.description: An item pricing count of a VSOE price set.

columns.name: TOTAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total line amount of a price basis data set.

columns.name: TOTAL_QUANTITY
columns.description: Total quantity of a price basis data set.

columns.name: STANDARD_DEVIATION
columns.description: Stores the standard deviation of the FMV based on the FMV price basis line set used for calculating the FMV.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_COVERAGE
columns.description: Stores the percentage of standalone sales that its unit selling price falls within tolerance range price of an item.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_COVERAGE_COUNT
columns.description: Stores the number of standalone sales that its unit selling price falls within tolerance range price of an item.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_ACTION
columns.description: An action taken on a VSOE price with exception status. An exception VSOE price can be determined if it is a valid or invalid VSOE price by a revenue analyst or manager. Lookup Name: VSOE Price Exception Line Status.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of a fair market value exception. Value is either Manual or System. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_PRICE_EXLINE_TYPE.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_REASON
columns.description: A reason that a revenue analyst or manager needs to provide in order to mark a VSOE price for an item as invalid. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_PRICE_EXLINE_REASON.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_COMMENT
columns.description: User entered comments.

columns.name: MINIMUM_LINE_COUNT
columns.description: Minimum number of standalone sales required in order to calculate a valid VSOE price.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_RANGE_COVERAGE
columns.description: The required minimum percentage of standalone sales that its unit selling price falls within tolerance range price of an item.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: USED_IN_COMPLIANCE
columns.description: Indicates whether the FMV line has been used in compliance process. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: MANUALLY_ENTERED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the FMV value is the manually added by the user. Possible values are Yes or No.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: The comments entered by the user for the FMV line if FMV is rejected.

columns.name: PRICE_EFF_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: VSOE price effectivity period unique identifier.

columns.name: LINE_SOURCE
columns.description: Indicates the source of the sets if Manual or System generated, where Manual indicates that the price is manually entered.

columns.name: FMV_TYPE
columns.description: Fair Market Value price type of the item. Possible values are VSOE, TPE, or ESP.

columns.name: VSOE_VALUE_STATUS
columns.description: Status of VSOE value. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_PRICE_LINE_STATUS.

columns.name: REVIEW_STATUS
columns.description: Status of VSOE value review. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_VALUE_REVIEW_STATUS.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate of the VSOE value.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_DATE
columns.description: Conversion rate date of the VSOE value.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type of the VSOE value.

columns.name: COVERAGE_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the coverage period used to compute VSOE value.

columns.name: COVERAGE_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the coverage period used to compute VSOE value.

columns.name: VALUE_REASON
columns.description: Used to identify value status reason of the VSOE value. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_VALUE_REASON.

columns.name: REVIEW_REASON
columns.description: Used to identify value review status reason of the VSOE value. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_VALUE_REVIEW_REASON.

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Element is a deliverable or separate unit of accounting. Used to group element types for FMV sets. Values are from the lookup VRM_ELEMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: ESTABLISHED_BY
columns.description: User who established the fair market value.

columns.name: ESTABLISHED_DATE
columns.description: Date the fair market value is established.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the performance obligation template that is used to group the source document lines under a single performance obligation.

columns.name: SSP_LOW
columns.description: The low point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: SSP_MID
columns.description: The mid point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: SSP_HIGH
columns.description: The high point of the acceptable standalone selling price ranges. This value is used to determine the unit standalone selling price in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy for ranges.

columns.name: PUBLISHED_SALES_POINT
columns.description: The price determined and published by the business as published sales point of an item or service.

columns.name: BELOW_RANGE_SSP_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule to be used in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business when the actual value is below the SSP Low Point. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: IN_RANGE_SSP_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule to be used in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business when the actual value is between the SSP Low and SSP High Points. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: ABOVE_RANGE_SSP_RULE_CODE
columns.description: The rule to be used in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business when the actual value is above the SSP High Point. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SSP_RANGE_CODE.

columns.name: SSP_RANGE_TOLERANCE_PERCENT
columns.description: The tolerance percentage in accordance with the Standalone Selling Price policy of the business. The SSP Low Point and SSP High Point are calculated by the application when the SSP tolerance percentage and SSP midpoint are provided for an item or service.
